import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pymupdf
from docx import Document
from docx.enum.text import WD_LINE_SPACING
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.shared import Pt

root = Path('/tmp/docweave-blank-runs')
root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
mode = sys.argv[1]
cases = ['empty-run', 'hidden-run', 'field-code', 'mark-8', 'mark-30']
if mode == 'generate':
    for case in cases:
        doc = Document()
        doc.styles['Normal'].font.size = Pt(11)
        table = doc.add_table(rows=3, cols=1)
        table.style = 'Table Grid'
        margins = OxmlElement('w:tblCellMar')
        for side in ['top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right']:
            child = OxmlElement('w:' + side)
            child.set(qn('w:w'), '0')
            child.set(qn('w:type'), 'dxa')
            margins.append(child)
        table._tbl.tblPr.append(margins)
        for row in table.rows:
            p = row.cells[0].paragraphs[0]
            pf = p.paragraph_format
            pf.space_before = Pt(0)
            pf.space_after = Pt(0)
            if case.startswith('mark-'):
                pf.line_spacing = 1.0
                mark = OxmlElement('w:rPr')
                size = OxmlElement('w:sz')
                size.set(qn('w:val'), str(int(case.split('-')[1])*2))
                mark.append(size)
                p._p.get_or_add_pPr().append(mark)
                p.add_run('').font.size = Pt(80)
            else:
                pf.line_spacing = Pt(30)
                pf.line_spacing_rule = WD_LINE_SPACING.EXACTLY
                if case == 'field-code':
                    for kind in ['begin', 'end']:
                        run = OxmlElement('w:r')
                        field = OxmlElement('w:fldChar')
                        field.set(qn('w:fldCharType'), kind)
                        run.append(field)
                        p._p.append(run)
                        if kind == 'begin':
                            run = OxmlElement('w:r')
                            text = OxmlElement('w:instrText')
                            text.text = 'DOCPROPERTY SECRET'
                            run.append(text)
                            p._p.append(run)
                else:
                    run = p.add_run('SECRET' if case == 'hidden-run' else '')
                    run.font.size = Pt(80)
                    run.font.hidden = case == 'hidden-run'
        doc.save(root/f'{case}.docx')
    raise SystemExit
if mode == 'baseline':
    sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/docweave-mark-height-baseline')
import aspose.words_foss as aw
from aspose.words_foss.libreoffice import convert_to_pdf
result = {}
for case in cases:
    source, output = root/f'{case}.docx', root/f'{mode}-{case}.pdf'
    if mode == 'native':
        convert_to_pdf(source, output)
    else:
        document = aw.Document(source)
        output.write_bytes(document.to_bytes(aw.saving.PdfSaveOptions()))
    with pymupdf.open(output) as pdf:
        page_records=[]
        for page in pdf:
            ys=sorted(set(round(item[1].y,3) for d in page.get_drawings() for item in d['items']
                          if item[0]=='l' and abs(item[1].y-item[2].y)<0.01))
            page_records.append({'horizontal_lines':ys,'text':page.get_text().strip()})
            page.get_pixmap(matrix=pymupdf.Matrix(2,2)).save(root/f'{mode}-{case}-{page.number}.png')
        result[case]={'pages':len(pdf),'bytes':output.stat().st_size,'geometry':page_records}
(root/f'{mode}.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))

import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import pymupdf
import aspose.words_foss as aw
assert 'site-packages' in aw.__file__,aw.__file__
root=Path('/tmp/docweave-current-performance');results={}
for case in ('small','hundred_pages','image_table','repeated_images','mixed_styles'):
 raw=aw.Document(root/(case+'.docx')).to_bytes(aw.saving.PdfSaveOptions())
 pages=[]
 with pymupdf.open(stream=raw,filetype='pdf') as pdf:
  for page in pdf:
   pages.append({key:hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest() for key,value in {'words':repr(page.get_text('words')).encode(),'pixels':page.get_pixmap().samples,'drawings':repr(page.get_drawings()).encode(),'images':repr(page.get_image_info()).encode()}.items()})
 results[case]={'bytes':len(raw),'pages':pages}
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n');print('five PDF corpora saved')
